messages:
Nora K.: Putting this here — found a curious divergence between hosted canary and dedicated-staging for rwd-v2.12-int4 on the multilingual-summaries slice (es/es-legal).
Ibrahim A.: Divergence how?
Nora K.: Hosted canary shows BLEU-ish style parity (delta ~0.6), dedicated-staging shows a consistent drop (delta ~3.7) and higher hallucination markers on Spanish legal docs.
Sam P.: Are model binaries identical? Quant profile same?
Nora K.: Yes: model_tag=rwd-v2.12, quant=nl4-int4, build_sha=88fa2c. Differences: dedicated uses kernel runtime crt-1.6.2 with cuda 12.1, hosted uses crt-1.6.0 with cuda 11.8 (ops pinned older). suspected kernel/driver mismatch.
ops-bot: note: dedicated pool recently onboarded new gpu-kernel nodes in eu-west-1 on 2026-02-14.
Ibrahim A.: Interesting. Our rollout gating rules include cross-environment parity: if primary slice delta >2.5 in any env -> hold. We rarely hit env-specific divergence.
Nora K.: I ran a small stratified shadow (n=1500) on both infra and captured token-diff heatmaps; dedicated exhibits larger token-embedding drift for rare Spanish legal tokens (accents + ligatures).
Sam P.: Could be quant calibration bins differ due to float rounding in kernel operations. Proposal: block promotion, run a targeted 5k reproducibility run on both infra variants with identical seeds and enable deterministic math flags. Also try variant: int4 + per-channel recalibration on dedicated nodes.
Ibrahim A.: Decision: hold any promote to global. Run 5k paired shadow across hosted+dedicated, compare per-token KL, embedding cosine, and hallucination rate. If dedicated-specific artifacts improve with per-channel recalib (cosine delta <0.03 and hallucination uplift <1.0%) -> allow a region-scoped split (route eu-west-1 to fp16-stable until fix). Else trigger auto-fallback globally.
telemetry: queued paired runs (id=6831239999-paired). Will post interim every 15m.
Nora K.: I'll also upload failing pairs and the token-heatmaps link. Adding run snippet I used:
```
# pseudo
seed=42
variants=["hosted-crt1.6.0","dedicated-crt1.6.2"]
res=run_paired_shadow(variants,n=5000,seed=seed,stratify=slice=="multilingual-summaries" and lang=="es")
compare_metrics(res,metrics=["embed_cosine","token_kl","hallucination_rate","latency_p95"]) 
```
Sam P.: ops: please prepare a routing policy that can soft-pin eu-west-1 to fp16 if telemetry posts a fail. Chloe (if watching), can we get an ops playbook entry?
ops-bot: prepared policy stub: soft-pin-region -> route region->fp16, watch=30m, notify=on-fail. Will validate once telemetry final.
deploy-bot: paired shadow runs complete: 5000/5000 processed. Results posted: https://dash.internal/runs/6831239999-paired
telemetry: interim agg (15m): dedicated token_kl median=0.045 vs hosted 0.012; embed_cosine delta=0.039 dedicated->hosted; hallucination uplift dedicated=1.6%
Nora K.: that's not great. Keep running for final.
telemetry: final agg: token_kl dedicated=0.058, hosted=0.014; embed_cosine delta median=0.048; hallucination uplift dedicated=2.3% (vs hosted). latency p95 neutral.
Ibrahim A.: Verdict per policy: dedicated-specific breach exceeds region threshold -> execute soft-pin for eu-west-1 to fp16-stable and open triage ticket.
ops-bot: executing soft-pin-region for eu-west-1: routing 60%->fp16-stable for 30m, notify ["Nora K.","Ibrahim A."]. Incident ticket #INC-6831239999 created.
Sam P.: I'll start kernel-compat triage: reproduce minimal failing case under dedicated kernel, capture fused-kernel numerics, and test per-channel recalib candidate.
Nora K.: Thanks. We'll follow up here with triage notes and candidate rollout plan (region-first canary).
